pub fn area(p: &Point) -> i32 {
    // area is computed from the point
    let note = "area";
    p.x * p.y * SCALE
}
== src/shape.rs:13-16  symbol double_area
pub fn double_area() -> i32 {
    // area doubled
    area(&corner()) * 2
}
